contract: Apply the Pulse Gym, Stretch Out Pulse, and Padel Up Pulse moodboards as a cohesive premium editorial club interface while preserving the complete booking application.

renderedEvidence.observation: The member home renders the cinematic gym hero, editorial typography, numbered service system, upcoming bookings, membership status, and restrained navigation without visible overflow.

accessibility.evidence: Chrome Lighthouse mobile navigation audit scored Accessibility 100 with all audited checks passing.

responsive.evidence: The mobile navigation audit completed at the emulated mobile viewport with Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO, and Agentic Browsing all scoring 100; the responsive card and navigation layouts remained usable.

loading.reason: The static shell initializes synchronously and the optional remote configuration poll does not block the interface.

empty.evidence: The application retains its explicit empty-list copy for accounts without upcoming reservations.

error.evidence: Slow Google Apps Script JSONP responses now resolve to a silent fallback without uncaught console errors.

partial.reason: Service modules are rendered independently and do not expose a distinct partial-result screen.

success.evidence: The populated member state rendered booking confirmations, membership status, and all three service entry points.

permission.reason: The reviewed member route does not request browser-level permissions.
